findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Targets.lean:126` declares `theorem windingNumber_at_i ...`; `rg -n "theorem windingNumber_at_i|theorem windingNumber_modelSector_pi" code/TauCeti roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Targets.lean` finds only `windingNumber_modelSector_pi` in the implementation at line 97.
findings.fix: Add a public theorem/alias `windingNumber_at_i` with the same statement, proved from `windingNumber_modelSector_pi`.
findings.issue: The public API exposes the semicircle specialization only as `windingNumber_modelSector_pi`, but the roadmap target is `windingNumber_at_i`.

findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Targets.lean:135` declares `theorem windingNumber_at_rho ...`; `rg -n "theorem windingNumber_at_rho|theorem windingNumber_modelSector_pi_div_three" code/TauCeti roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Targets.lean` finds only `windingNumber_modelSector_pi_div_three` in the implementation at line 110.
findings.fix: Add a public theorem/alias `windingNumber_at_rho` with the same statement, proved from `windingNumber_modelSector_pi_div_three`.
findings.issue: The public API exposes the `π/3` specialization only as `windingNumber_modelSector_pi_div_three`, but the roadmap target is `windingNumber_at_rho`.

summary: The raw-integral computations are present, but two roadmap-facing names are missing from the public API. Downstream code targeting the pinned Layer 1 declarations cannot refer to the `i` and `ρ` coefficients by their roadmap names without unfolding the naming mismatch.
